name: Action Active
description: Fires TRUE when the named action on this node matches the chosen state. The action must have an instance name set.

name: Always
description: Always active trigger. Fires every frame. Useful for continuous actions like gravity or idle animations.

name: Animation Tree
description: Detects animation tree state changes and conditions.

name: Collision
description: Detects collisions using this Area3D or an Area3D that is a direct child of the node using Logic Bricks.

name: Compare Variable
description: Compares a variable's value. Works with local, exported, and global variables. Automatically checks GlobalVars if not found locally.
props: Equal,Not Equal,Interval,Changed,Greater Than,Less Than,Greater or Equal,Less or Equal

name: Delay
description: Waits for Delay seconds, then stays active for Duration seconds. Repeat cycles the whole sequence.

name: Input
description: Detects input actions from Project > Input Map. Supports button presses, any-action checks, and analog joystick axis input.
props: Pressed,Just Pressed,Just Released,Any Pressed,Any Just Pressed,Any Just Released,Axis

name: Mouse
description: Detects mouse buttons, wheel movement, mouse motion, and mouse hover ray hits.

name: Movement Detected
description: Detects if the node is moving in specific directions. Check which directions to monitor. Active when any checked direction moves past the threshold.

name: Proximity
description: Detects objects within a distance and optional angle. Uses groups to filter which objects are detected.

name: Random Chance
description: Activates randomly each time it is evaluated. Pair with a Delay Trigger to control how often it rolls. Useful for random behaviors, AI variation, and loot rolls.

name: Raycast Hit
description: Detects along a RayCast3D. This can be used for objects, groups, walls, ground, or ledges. The RayCast3D's direction, length, and collision mask are set on the RayCast3D node itself.

name: Signal Receive
description: Detects signals sent by a Signal Send Action. Listens for a specific Signal name.

name: Surface Check
description: Checks CharacterBody3D collision state: on floor, on wall, on ceiling, or just landed. Use Landed for landing sounds, camera shake, particles, and other impact effects.

name: Gate
description: Logic gate that combines Trigger inputs. AND: all Triggers must be active. OR: any Trigger active. NAND/NOR/XOR: inverted and exclusive logic.

name: Script Gate
description: Calls a function in a custom .gd script when triggers fire. Runs a custom GDScript module function: no separate Action is needed — the script performs the action.

name: Animation
description: Play, stop, or control animations by name. Automatically finds the AnimationPlayer that owns the animation. Works with AnimationPlayers nested at any depth.

name: Animation State
description: Beginner-friendly AnimationTree control. Use Go To State for normal character animations. Blending comes from the transition Xfade Time inside the AnimationTree.
props: Go To State:go_to_state,Set Blend Parameter:set_parameter,Advanced - Set Condition:set_condition_value

name: Sprite3D Animation
description: Play, stop, or pause Sprite3D / AnimatedSprite3D frame animations. Finds the target by name anywhere in the scene tree. Leave Target Node empty to use the node this script is on.

name: 2D Audio
description: Play 2D/UI audio from a file. Creates its own AudioStreamPlayer at runtime — no @export needed.

name: 3D Audio
description: Plays audio with advanced options. Supports random pitch, audio buses, and multiple play modes.

name: Music
description: Three modes: Tracks: define and create music players at startup. Set: set which track is current (and optionally play it). Control: play, stop, pause, resume, or crossfade from current to another track.

name: 3rd Person Camera
description: Third-person camera setup: 1. Add a Node3D named CameraPivot near the character's head/shoulders. 2. Add a Camera3D and place it behind/above the pivot. 3. Choose both nodes with the dropdowns below. They may live anywhere in the scene. 4. Run this action continuously (for example Always → AND → 3rd Person Camera). The brick handles mouse/gamepad orbit and pitch clamp. Turn on Avoid Walls (Wall Avoidance group) so walls never block the view.

name: Camera Zoom
description: Changes a camera's FOV (3D) or zoom (2D). Choose the camera by name; it is found anywhere in the current scene.

name: Set Camera
description: Makes a Camera3D anywhere in the edited scene active. Use the dropdown to choose the camera. A one-shot sensor is usually best so make_current() is not called every frame.

name: Smooth Follow Camera
description: Smoothly follows this node with the assigned Camera3D, maintaining the camera's initial offset from the target. Position follow: camera tracks the node's position per axis. Rotation follow: camera orbits the node, keeping it in frame. Dead zone: camera only moves once the node exceeds the threshold. Choose the Camera3D by name; it is found anywhere in the current scene.

name: Split Screen
description: Creates a split screen layout. Apply Code always builds all 4 SubViewportContainers. Each player count has its own independent layout. Change split_screen_players at runtime to switch counts without re-applying code. ** Use an Always sensor so the layout updates every frame.

name: Light
description: Control a light node's properties and apply animated FX effects. Leave Target Light blank to affect this node, or enter another light node name.
props: blank = self, or light node name

name: World Environment
description: Modifies WorldEnvironment properties at runtime. Choose the WorldEnvironment by name; it is found anywhere in the current scene. All value fields accept a number or a variable name / expression.

name: Game
description: Game-level actions: quit, restart, or pause the game.

name: Preload
description: Preloads resources (materials, scenes, textures, audio, meshes) into memory before they are needed, preventing runtime hitches and frame drops.

name: Save / Load
description: Saves or loads game state to/from a JSON file. Three scopes — no custom save()/load() methods needed on any node. • This Node: saves the node this brick is on • Target Node: saves a specific node found by name • Group: saves every node in a named group

name: Scene
description: Changes or manages scenes. Can switch to a new scene or reload the current one.

name: Hit Stop
description: Briefly pauses or slows game time when an impact lands. Use for attacks, damage, blocks, heavy landings, and breaks. This is also called hit pause or impact freeze.

name: Object Flash
description: Flashes a mesh/object with a temporary color overlay. Type a node name, not a path. "self" also works on physics bodies by searching for a mesh child.

name: Object Shake
description: Shakes a named object by rotation, translation, or scale, then returns it to its starting value. Type a node name, not a path. Use multiple Object Shake actuators for multiple effects.

name: Particles
description: Controls a GPUParticles or CPUParticles node in 2D or 3D.

name: Rumble
description: Trigger controller haptic vibration. Vibrate: manual motor control for a set duration. Stop: immediately stop all vibration. Pattern: built-in presets that play to completion. The sensor only needs to fire once — the pattern finishes even if the sensor stops.

name: Screen Flash
description: Flashes a color over the screen. Press "Apply Code" and the plugin creates the required nodes automatically. Works automatically in both standard and split-screen setups.

name: Screen Shake
description: Trauma-based camera shake. Type the Camera3D node name. The generated script searches the whole current scene tree, so this brick can live on any 3D node.

name: Get Variable
description: Reads a variable/property from self, another node, or GlobalVars, then stores it as a local variable that later bricks can use. Useful for UI health bars, ammo labels, score text, and timers.

name: Modify Variable
description: Modifies a variable's value. Works with local and global variables. Automatically uses GlobalVars if not found locally.

name: Random
description: Sets a variable to a random value within a range. Useful for randomized behavior, damage variation, etc.
props: Bool Constant,Bool Uniform,Bool Bernoulli,Int Constant,Int Uniform,Int Poisson,Float Constant,Float Uniform,Float Normal,Float Neg Exp

name: Signal Send
description: Sends a named signal to other nodes. Receiving nodes need a Signal Receive Trigger with a matching Signal name.

name: State
description: Changes the logic brick state (1-30). Only chains assigned to the active state will run.

name: Character Jump
description: Applies a jump impulse to a CharacterBody3D. Pair with any sensor — InputMap, Proximity, Message, etc. The Character Actuator handles gravity and resets the jump counter when grounded. Both actuators share _jumps_remaining and _on_ground automatically.

name: Look At Input
description: Rotates a Node3D to face the combined Input Map direction instead of the movement/slide direction. Named targets are searched across the current scene.

name: Look At Movement
description: Rotates a child Node3D to face the direction of movement. The target is resolved only beneath this Logic Bricks node.

name: Mouse
description: Controls cursor visibility, mouse-look rotation, and mouse cursor world interactions.
props: Cursor Visibility,Mouse Look,Look Towards,Move Towards Cursor,Move To Mouse Click

name: Path Follow
description: Moves this node through a series of waypoints or along an editable Path3D curve.

name: Position
description: Changes where a 3D object is. Use Character Velocity for CharacterBody3D movement, Translate for an offset, or Set Position for an exact location.

name: Rotate Towards
description: Rotates this node to face a target found by name or group. Useful for turrets, enemies tracking a player, or any look-at behaviour.

name: Rotation
description: Rotates a 3D object. This actuator controls rotation only.

name: Steering
description: Steers a node using reusable movement behaviors. Seek: move toward a target Flee: move away Arrive: slow as the target is reached Wander: move with changing randomized headings Maintain Distance: approach or retreat to hold a range Orbit: circle a target Path Follow: use NavigationAgent3D for obstacle-aware movement.

name: Teleport
description: Instantly sets position to a target node or coordinates. Useful for respawning, portals, checkpoints. Target Node mode finds the destination by name anywhere in the current scene.

name: Edit Object
description: Add, remove, or replace objects in the scene at runtime. Useful for spawning enemies, projectiles, or swapping meshes.

name: Get Transform
description: Gets transform data from a Node2D or Node3D and stores each selected value as a variable for later bricks.

name: Group
description: Changes group membership at runtime. Works in both 2D and 3D. Leave Target Node blank to affect the node that owns these Logic Bricks.

name: Node Properties
description: Sets an Inspector property on Self or another node. The Property list updates to match the selected Target Node.

name: Object Pool
description: Spawns objects from reusable pools. Faster than instancing — reuses inactive nodes. Pools are created at startup.

name: Parent
description: Changes the node's parent in the scene tree. Useful for attaching objects to characters or vehicles.

name: Set Transform
description: Changes any combination of position, rotation, and scale on a Node2D or Node3D.

name: Visibility
description: Shows, hides, or toggles visibility of a node by name. Uses the same current-scene recursive name lookup as the Text Action.

name: Character Physics
description: CharacterBody3D body rules: gravity, fall speed, floor snapping, slope limit, acceleration, friction, bounce, ground detection, and move_and_slide(). Horizontal speed is still controlled by movement Actions. Jumping is handled by the Character Jump Action.

name: Collision
description: Modifies collision properties at runtime. Can enable/disable shapes, change layers/masks, or toggle Area3D monitoring.
props: Disable Shape,Enable Shape,Set Layer Bit,Set Mask Bit,Enable Monitoring,Disable Monitoring

name: Force
description: Applies continuous central force to a RigidBody3D or SoftBody3D. On a SoftBody3D the force is distributed across all simulated points.

name: Gravity
description: Applies custom gravity to RigidBody3D or SoftBody3D. Soft bodies receive a central force while the brick is active.

name: Impulse
description: Applies a one-shot impulse. RigidBody3D supports Central, Positional, and Torque. SoftBody3D supports Central; use Soft Body Point Impulse for a specific mesh point.

name: Linear Velocity
description: Sets, adds to, or averages the linear_velocity of a RigidBody3D. Requires a RigidBody3D node.

name: Physics
description: Controls physics properties. Mass and Linear Damping support RigidBody3D and SoftBody3D; Soft Body actions expose native SoftBody3D properties.
props: Suspend Physics,Resume Physics,Set Mass,Set Gravity Scale,Set Linear Damping,Set Angular Damping,Enable Contact Monitor,Disable Contact Monitor,Set Soft Body Drag,Set Soft Body Stiffness,Set Soft Body Pressure,Set Soft Body Shrinking,Set Soft Body Simulation Precision

name: Soft Body Point Force
description: Applies continuous force to one SoftBody3D mesh point. Point indices refer to the soft body's simulated mesh points.

name: Soft Body Point Impulse
description: Applies a one-shot impulse to one SoftBody3D mesh point. Use this for localized impacts and deformation.

name: Surface Attachment
description: Attach to a physically touching surface, or detach. Supports rigid bodies and characters in 3D and 2D. Use a Collision or Surface Check trigger to choose when to attach.

name: Torque
description: Applies a rotational force (torque) to a RigidBody3D each physics frame. Requires a RigidBody3D node.

name: Collision 2D
description: Detects collisions via an Area2D node. Leave Area Node Name blank when these Logic Bricks are attached directly to the Area2D. Otherwise, enter the node name (not the full path).

name: Movement Detected
description: Detects if a 2D node is moving in specific directions. Check which directions to monitor. Active when any checked direction moves past the threshold.

name: Surface Check
description: Checks CharacterBody2D collision state: on floor, on wall, on ceiling, or just landed. Use Landed for landing sounds, camera shake, particles, and other impact effects.

name: Proximity 2D
description: Detects objects within a distance and optional angle. Uses groups to filter which objects are detected.

name: Raycast Hit 2D
description: Detects along a RayCast2D. This can be used for objects, groups, walls, ground, or ledges. The RayCast2D's direction, length, and collision mask are set on the RayCast2D node itself.

name: Sprite Animation
description: Play, stop, or pause AnimatedSprite2D animations. Leave Target Node empty to use the node this script is on.

name: Tween
description: Animates any property on self or on a node found by name anywhere in the current scene tree.

name: Camera Zoom
description: Changes Camera2D zoom. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = zoomed in, 0.5 = zoomed out.

name: Set Camera
description: Makes the named Camera2D the active camera. Use a one-shot sensor when possible so make_current() is not called every frame.

name: Smooth Follow Camera
description: Smoothly follows this Node2D with the named Camera2D while maintaining the camera's initial offset from the target.

name: Split Screen
description: Configures a 2D split-screen layout using SubViewports and Camera2D nodes.

name: Save / Load
description: Saves or restores 2D gameplay state for checkpoints and simple save systems.

name: Camera Shake
description: Shakes a Camera2D and returns it to its original offset and rotation.

name: Object Flash
description: Flashes a 2D object with a temporary color tint. Type a node name, not a path.

name: Object Shake
description: Shakes a Node2D by position, rotation, or scale, then returns it to its starting transform.

name: Character 2D Physics
description: Applies reusable character physics to a CharacterBody2D. Pair with Position and Character Jump for player movement.

name: Character Jump 2D
description: Applies a jump to a CharacterBody2D. Pair with Character Physics for gravity and grounded behavior.

name: Mouse
description: Uses the mouse for 2D cursor visibility, aiming, rotation, and move-toward behavior.
props: Cursor Visibility,Mouse Look,Look Towards,Move Towards Cursor,Move To Mouse Click

name: Path Follow
description: Moves this node through editable Node2D waypoint points or along a Path2D curve.

name: Position 2D
description: Changes where a 2D object is. Use Character Velocity for CharacterBody2D movement, Translate for an offset, or Set Position for an exact location.

name: Rotate Towards
description: Turns a Node2D toward another node or the nearest member of a group.

name: Rotation 2D
description: Rotates a 2D object by a number of degrees.

name: Scale 2D
description: Changes only the scale of a 2D object. Enable Tween to animate to the target scale.

name: Steering
description: Steers a Node2D with Seek, Flee, Arrive, Wander, Maintain Distance, or Orbit behaviors.

name: Teleport 2D
description: Instantly sets position to a target Node2D or coordinates. Useful for respawning, portals, checkpoints, and spawn points.

name: Parent
description: Parents this 2D node to another scene node or the first node in a group, or removes its current parent.

name: Collisions
description: Enables, disables, or edits 2D collision settings on a target node.
props: Disable Shape,Enable Shape,Set Layer Bit,Set Mask Bit,Enable Monitoring,Disable Monitoring

name: Force
description: Applies continuous force to a RigidBody2D. X/Y fields accept numbers, variables, or expressions.

name: Gravity
description: Sets persistent directional gravity on a RigidBody2D.

name: Impulse 2D
description: Applies an instant push to a RigidBody2D. Use Force when the push should continue over time.

name: Linear Velocity 2D
description: Directly sets velocity on a RigidBody2D or CharacterBody2D.

name: Always
description: Runs continuously while this logic chain is active. Useful for UI updates that need to happen every frame.

name: Button
description: Detects UI button state from a Button node. Leave Target Node Name blank to use self only when this Logic Bricks graph is on the Button itself.

name: Delay
description: Waits for Delay seconds, then stays active for Duration seconds. Repeat cycles the whole sequence.

name: Input
description: Detects input actions from Project > Input Map. Supports button presses, any-action checks, and analog joystick axis input.
props: Pressed,Just Pressed,Just Released,Any Pressed,Any Just Pressed,Any Just Released,Axis

name: Random Chance
description: Activates randomly each time it is evaluated. Pair with a Delay Trigger to control how often it rolls. Useful for random behaviors, AI variation, and loot rolls.

name: Signal Receive
description: Detects signals sent by a Signal Send Action. Listens for a specific Signal name.

name: Variable
description: Compares a variable's value. Works with local, exported, and global variables. Automatically checks GlobalVars if not found locally.
props: Equal,Not Equal,Interval,Changed,Greater Than,Less Than,Greater or Equal,Less or Equal

name: 2D Audio
description: Play 2D/UI audio from a file. Creates its own AudioStreamPlayer at runtime — no @export needed.

name: Button
description: Controls a BaseButton such as Button, CheckBox, or TextureButton.

name: Color / Transparency
description: Sets or smoothly transitions the color/alpha of a UI or 2D node found by name anywhere in the current scene tree.

name: Focus
description: Grabs or releases UI focus on a Control node.

name: Popup
description: Controls a Popup, PopupPanel, AcceptDialog, Window, or visible Control.

name: Progress Bar
description: Sets the value, min, or max of a ProgressBar, HSlider, VSlider, or any Range node found by name anywhere in the current scene tree.

name: Screen Flash
description: Flashes a color over the screen. Press "Apply Code" and the plugin creates the required nodes automatically. Works automatically in both standard and split-screen setups.

name: Scroll
description: Moves a ScrollContainer by setting or adding to its scroll position.

name: Slider
description: Changes the value of HSlider, VSlider, ProgressBar, SpinBox, or another Range node.

name: Tab
description: Sets, advances, or reverses the active TabContainer tab.

name: Text
description: Updates a Label, Label3D, or RichTextLabel by node name. Searches the whole current scene tree, so this brick can live on any node.

name: Tween
description: Animates any property on self or on a node found by name anywhere in the current scene tree.

name: Visibility
description: Shows, hides, or toggles visibility of a node by name. Uses the same current-scene recursive name lookup as the Text Action.

name: Window
description: Controls a Godot Window node, such as a settings or dialog window.
